Same identity, face, hair, outfit, head and body scale across all four views. Every head and shoe fully visible, with broad transparent gutters and outer margins.
Style/medium: compact rounded proportions, large expressive head, crisp softly shaded pixel art and clean dark pixel-stepped outline matching Image1.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA background. No hat, chair, furniture, floor, cast shadow, glow, props, devices, scenery, text, readable badge, logo, watermark, collage, grid, extra people, varied poses or cropped limbs.
